messages:
Maya (Design): Pushed new Figma frames for the rollout history filters + compact mode. quick link: https://www.figma.com/file/xyz-rollout-facets Maya (Design): main ask: do the facets make sense? can we support quick undo for rollbacks in this list view? Arjun (PM): looked — love the compact rows. Q: is ‘Undo rollback’ going to be a per-row action or a global timeline undo? Maya (Design): thinking per-row for recent rollbacks (15min window) + global undo for multi-step reverts. need microcopy for the action. Noah (Eng-Frontend): per-row seems fine. Concern: too many interactive controls will bloat keyboard nav. Can we collapse actions under a kebab menu? :thinking_face: Zoe (Accessibility): If actions are in a menu, ensure focus order is predictable and menu labels are unique. Also need an aria-live region announcing successful undo. Priya (Eng-Backend): backend wise, undo requires storing last-deployed snapshot id and a short TTL. We can add a flag and endpoint, but need to limit to last 3 rollbacks to avoid state bloat. Ben (ProductOps): +1 on TTL. Also want an audit trail link visible at row level (opens full deployment details) — ops need quick context before undo. Maya (Design): copy options: option A: "Undo rollback" (danger/confirm). option B (softer): "Reinstate previous version". Thoughts? Arjun (PM): lean toward B for clarity. But show a red confirm modal: "Reinstate version v5.2.1? This will replace current active version." Confirm / Cancel. Zoe (Accessibility): For the modal, include role=alertdialog, aria-describedby pointing to change summary, and the confirm button labelled with the version to be reinstated (e.g., "Reinstate v5.2.1") so screen readers hear context. Noah (Eng-Frontend): UI/implementation questions: filters are client-side for small workspaces, server-side for larger orgs. We should provide a single API param set for facets so backend can handle no matter what. Priya, can we accept a facets[] param? Priya (Eng-Backend): yes, facets[] with key:value pairs is fine. We'll also add pagination and a compact=true flag. Expect a small index change; I'll spike. Maya (Design): filters proposed: Status (deployed/rolled back/failed), Author, Canary %, Date range, Region, Deployment ID, Tag. Also quick search by message text. Ben (ProductOps): Add "SLA-impacting" facet (bool) so we can filter for high-priority rollouts. Noah (Eng-Frontend): Suggest hiding less-used facets behind a "More filters" collapse — keeps default row height small. Keyboard: ensure collapse toggle is focusable and aria-expanded toggles properly. Zoe (Accessibility): Also need labels for the canary allocation slider: use aria-valuetext like "Canary allocation: 20 percent" and a visible numeric readout. Tooltip alone isn't enough. Maya (Design): thanks. I'll add numeric readout. Also thinking about an inline mini-timeline icon that opens a quick diff — small affordance so users can preview what changed without leaving list. Arjun (PM): love preview, but warn on perf. Noah / Priya, can previews be lazy-loaded? Noah (Eng-Frontend): yes, lazy load via hover/focus fetch; show skeleton while loading. Keep previews client-side cache for session. Priya (Eng-Backend): will add lightweight summaries endpoint (deployments/:id/summary) returning small payload. rate-limit it per session. Maya (Design): microcopy for empty state filters: "No rollouts match these filters. Try clearing date range or tags." — ok? Ben (ProductOps): good. Add quick CTA: "View recent rollouts" to reset filters. Zoe (Accessibility): for empty state, ensure the CTA is the first focusable element and has descriptive text for screen readers (e.g., "Reset filters and show recent rollouts"). Noah (Eng-Frontend): small code snippet for aria-live we can reuse in the undo flow:
Rollback reinstated: v5.2.1
Noah (Eng-Frontend): will add role=log for streamy events if we need it to be persistent. Maya (Design): quick visual nit: the current facets use pill-style chips. can we reduce contrast on inactive chips so primary ones stand out? Zoe (Accessibility): ensure contrast still meets 3:1 for focus states and 4.5:1 for text. If you reduce contrast for inactive chips, add clear focus indicator. Arjun (PM): action items: Maya to update Figma with numeric readout + undo modal copy (D-2345), Noah spike keyboard nav and preview skeleton, Priya implement facets[] api and summary endpoint, Zoe to produce a short a11y checklist for rollout list. Maya (Design): thanks — I'll iterate and ping here when updated. :eyes: design-bot: Uploaded image 'rollout-facets-v2.png' (preview) Noah (Eng-Frontend): quick follow-up: can someone double-check expected default sort? I vote most-recent-deployment desc. Arjun (PM): agreed most-recent first. Also add a user-settable default saved across sessions. Ben (ProductOps): saved defaults are huge for power users. +1. Maya (Design): noted. updating frames now, will rename layers for dev handoff. Arjun (PM): thanks everyone — will collect these into D-2345 and assign tasks. Priya (Eng-Backend): spike ETA: 3d. Noah (Eng-Frontend): ETA for keyboard + preview spike: 2d. Zoe (Accessibility): checklist draft by EOD tom. Maya (Design): will post new Figma link when ready. Ben (ProductOps): tagging for release notes: 'rollouts: filters, undo, preview'. Maya (Design): cool — closing for now, will reopen if new questions. :slightly_smiling_face:
